cards.name: Thousand-Year Storm
lines: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, copy it for each other instant and sorcery spell you've cast before it this turn. You may choose new targets for the copies.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The number of copies equals the count of earlier instant and sorcery casts this turn, and no copy op takes a dynamic count.

cards.name: Bonehoard Dracosaur
lines: At the beginning of your upkeep, exile the top two cards of your library. You may play them this turn. If you exiled a land card this way, create a 3/1 red Dinosaur creature token. If you exiled a nonland card this way, create a Treasure token.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no condition for 'if you exiled a land card this way' (or nonland) to gate the Dinosaur and Treasure creation after exiling the top two cards, so the per-card-type token branches cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Grisly Salvage
lines: Reveal the top five cards of your library. You may put a creature or land card from among them into your hand. Put the rest into your graveyard.
cards.backTranslation: Look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a creature or land card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest into your graveyard.
differences: Text A reveals the top five cards to all players; Text B only looks at them, so the cards stay hidden from opponents

cards.name: Crawlspace
lines: No more than two creatures can attack you each combat.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No rule static caps how many creatures may attack you in a combat (attackTax and attackRestriction only tax or forbid by filter).

cards.name: Coiling Oracle
lines: When this creature enters, reveal the top card of your library. If it's a land card, put it onto the battlefield. Otherwise, put that card into your hand.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect reveals the top card and branches on whether it is a land (battlefield if it is, otherwise hand); lookAtTopN's mayPut cannot send a non-matching card to hand and leaves it on top of the library.

cards.name: Ominous Seas
lines: Remove eight foreshadow counters from this enchantment: Create an 8/8 blue Kraken creature token.
cards.backTranslation: Remove eight foreshadow counters from this permanent: Create an 8/8 blue Kraken creature token.

cards.name: Rings of Brighthearth
lines: Whenever you activate an ability, if it isn't a mana ability, you may pay {2}. If you do, copy that ability. You may choose new targets for the copy.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The pay-{2}-to-copy option is missing: copyActivatedAbility offers only the pay-life variant (mayPayLifeAgain), and no mana-payment form binds the copy to the activated ability.

cards.name: Magda, Brazen Outlaw
lines: Sacrifice five Treasures: Search your library for an artifact or Dragon card, put that card onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
cards.backTranslation: Sacrifice five other Treasures you control: Search your library for an artifact card or a Dragon card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
differences: Text A has this creature deal the 1 damage (the creature is the source); Text B has that player take 1 damage with no source named, so the damage source differs.

cards.name: Baral, Chief of Compliance
lines: Whenever a spell or ability you control counters a spell, you may draw a card. If you do, discard a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no trigger event for a spell or ability you control countering a spell.

cards.name: Goldvein Hydra
lines: When this creature dies, create a number of tapped Treasure tokens equal to its power.
validatorIssues: override.def.triggers[0].effects[0].count: event object information requires an owning permanent event scope
cards.backTranslation: When this creature dies, create a number of Treasure tokens equal to this creature's power. They enter tapped. Each of those tokens has "{T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add one mana of any color."

cards.name: Wave Goodbye
lines: Return each creature without a +1/+1 counter on it to its owner's hand.
cards.backTranslation: Return each creature that has no +1/+1 counters on it to its owner's hand.

cards.name: Snapcaster Mage
lines: When this creature enters, target instant or sorcery card in your graveyard gains flashback until end of turn. The flashback cost is equal to its mana cost.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect grants a graveyard card flashback until end of turn with a flashback cost equal to its own mana cost; the schema's flashback is only a fixed alternativeCasts entry on the card itself.

cards.name: Fake Your Own Death
lines: Until end of turn, target creature gets +2/+0 and gains "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control and you create a Treasure token."
cards.backTranslation: Target creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn and gains "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped. Create a token that is a Treasure artifact with '{T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add one mana of any color.'" until end of turn.
differences: Text A returns the creature to the battlefield under its owner's control; Text B does not say under whose control it returns.

cards.name: Baleful Mastery
lines: If the {1}{B} cost was paid, an opponent draws a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No condition reads whether the {1}{B} alternative cost was paid, and the only all-opponents draw would draw for every opponent rather than one opponent.

cards.name: Terastodon
lines: When this creature enters, you may destroy up to three target noncreature permanents. For each permanent put into a graveyard this way, its controller creates a 3/3 green Elephant creature token.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Destroying up to three chosen noncreature permanents and having each destroyed permanent's own controller create a 3/3 Elephant has no single effect: destroyAndCreateTokenForController handles one target only, and destroyEachChosen does not create tokens for controllers.

cards.name: Fling
lines: ~ deals damage equal to the sacrificed creature's power to any target.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Value has no reference to the power of the creature sacrificed as an additional cost, so 'damage equal to the sacrificed creature's power' cannot be stated.

cards.name: No Mercy
lines: Whenever a creature deals damage to you, destroy it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema does not say which object a playerDealtDamage trigger exposes for 'destroy it', and it has no filter restricting the damage source to creatures.

cards.name: Caduceus, Staff of Hermes
lines: As long as you have 30 or more life, equipped creature gets +5/+5 and has indestructible and "Prevent all damage that would be dealt to this creature."
cards.inexpressibleReason: Granting the equipped creature "prevent all damage that would be dealt to this creature" has no schema form; the only self-damage prevention static (preventCombatDamageToSelf) covers combat damage on its own permanent, not all damage on another permanent.

cards.name: Feign Death
lines: Until end of turn, target creature gains "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control with a +1/+1 counter on it."
cards.backTranslation: Target creature gains "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped with a +1/+1 counter on it." until end of turn.

cards.name: Eldrazi Monument
lines: At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice a creature. If you can't, sacrifice this artifact.
cards.backTranslation: At the beginning of your upkeep, if you control one or more creatures, sacrifice a creature you control. Otherwise, sacrifice this.
differences: Text B adds an intervening-if condition ('if you control one or more creatures') so the trigger does nothing when you control no creatures. Text A always triggers; if you control no creature, you sacrifice this artifact. Under Text B, the artifact is not sacrificed in that case.

cards.name: Elixir of Immortality
lines: {2}, {T}: You gain 5 life. Shuffle this artifact and your graveyard into their owner's library.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect shuffles this artifact from the battlefield together with the controller's graveyard into the owner's library (shuffleSourceFromGraveyardIntoLibrary needs the source in the graveyard, shuffleHandGraveyardIntoLibrary also shuffles the hand).

cards.name: Ancient Silver Dragon
lines: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, roll a d20. Draw cards equal to the result. You have no maximum hand size for the rest of the game.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no die-roll effect, so 'roll a d20 and draw cards equal to the result' cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Dark Deal
lines: Each player discards all the cards in their hand, then draws that many cards minus one.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Each player draws the number of cards they discarded minus one, but eachPlayerDiscardHandThenDraw offers only a fixed count or the greatest number discarded by any player, not each player's own discarded count.

cards.name: Monumental Henge
lines: {2}{W}{W}, {T}: Look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a historic card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
cards.backTranslation: {2}{W}{W}, {T}: Look at the top five cards of your library. You may put an artifact, legendary, or Saga card from among them into your hand. If you do, reveal it. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

cards.name: Grab the Prize
lines: Draw two cards. If the discarded card wasn't a land card, ~ deals 2 damage to each opponent.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema does not record the card type of the card discarded as the additional cost, so "if the discarded card wasn't a land card" cannot be checked.

cards.name: Rain of Riches
lines: The first spell you cast each turn that mana from a Treasure was spent to cast has cascade.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect or static grants cascade to a spell on the stack, so 'the first spell you cast each turn that Treasure mana was spent to cast has cascade' cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Misdirection
lines: Change the target of target spell with a single target.
cards.backTranslation: Change the target of target spell with a single target.

cards.name: Vedalken Orrery
lines: You may cast spells as though they had flash.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No rule static lets the controller cast spells as though they had flash; the RuleStatic kinds do not include a flash-granting permission.

cards.name: Treasure Nabber
lines: Whenever an opponent taps an artifact for mana, gain control of that artifact until the end of your next turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: gainControl supports only permanent, until end of turn, or while the source is on the battlefield; the schema cannot say 'until the end of your next turn'.

cards.name: Fauna Shaman
lines: {G}, {T}, Discard a creature card: Search your library for a creature card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The discardCard cost cannot be restricted to a creature card (it takes only a count), so 'Discard a creature card' cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Dark Depths
lines: When ~ has no ice counters on it, sacrifice it. If you do, create Marit Lage, a legendary 20/20 black Avatar creature token with flying and indestructible.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no state trigger for 'when this has no ice counters on it' (triggers are event-based only), so the sacrifice and Marit Lage creation cannot be tied to that state exactly.

cards.name: Cover of Darkness
lines: Creatures of the chosen type have fear.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Fear is not a keyword in the engine's KeywordAbility list (IMPLEMENTED_KEYWORDS), so addKeyword cannot grant it to creatures of the chosen type.

cards.name: Temur Battle Rage
lines: That creature also gains trample until end of turn if you control a creature with power 4 or greater.
cards.backTranslation: Target creature gains double strike until end of turn. If you control a creature with power 4 or greater, that creature also gains trample until end of turn.

cards.name: Diamond Pick-Axe
lines: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 and has "Whenever this creature attacks, create a Treasure token."
cards.backTranslation: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 and has "Whenever this creature attacks, create a Treasure token." The Treasure token has "{T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add one mana of your choice of {W}, {U}, {B}, {R}, or {G}."

cards.name: Obscuring Haze
lines: Prevent all damage that would be dealt this turn by creatures your opponents control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Preventing all damage this turn dealt by creatures your opponents control needs a damage prevention over a set of sources, but preventCombatDamageAll is combat-only and createDamageShield covers only damage to a player or to one named object.

cards.name: Thalia, Heretic Cathar
lines: Creatures and nonbasic lands your opponents control enter tapped.
cards.backTranslation:
Creatures your opponents control enter the battlefield tapped.
Nonbasic lands your opponents control enter the battlefield tapped.

cards.name: Ouroboroid
lines: At the beginning of combat on your turn, put X +1/+1 counters on each creature you control, where X is this creature's power.
cards.backTranslation: At the beginning of combat on your turn, put a number of +1/+1 counters equal to this creature's power on each creature you control.

cards.name: Arid Archway
lines: When this land enters, return a land you control to its owner's hand. If another Desert was returned this way, surveil 1.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No condition can test whether the land returned this way was another Desert, so the surveil 1 clause cannot be stated.

cards.name: In Garruk's Wake
lines: Destroy all creatures you don't control and all planeswalkers you don't control.
cards.backTranslation: Destroy each creature and each planeswalker that opponents control.

cards.name: Sneak Attack
lines: {R}: You may put a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield. That creature gains haste. Sacrifice the creature at the beginning of the next end step.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema cannot bind the creature put onto the battlefield by this ability so that it alone gains haste and is sacrificed at the next end step; handToBattlefield does not name the card it moved.

cards.name: Fell the Mighty
lines: Destroy all creatures with power greater than target creature's power.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The selector "power greater than target creature's power" needs a comparison against a target's power, but the only power selectors are constant thresholds (powerAtLeast, powerAtMost) and powerAtMostSource, which compares against the source rather than a target.

cards.name: Lizard Blades
lines: Reconfigure {2}
cards.inexpressibleReason: Reconfigure's "while attached, this isn't a creature" needs a condition that reads whether the source is attached, which no Condition provides, and its unattach mode has no effect form.

cards.name: Gratuitous Violence
lines: If a creature you control would deal damage to a permanent or player, it deals double that damage instead.
cards.backTranslation: If a creature you control would deal damage, it deals double that damage instead.

cards.name: Phantasmal Image
lines: You may have this creature enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it's an Illusion in addition to its other types and it has "When this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability, sacrifice it."
cards.inexpressibleReason: entersAsCopy's addTypes adds card types, and no field adds the Illusion creature subtype; the granted 'becomes the target, sacrifice it' ability has no entersAsCopy form to attach it.

cards.name: Coastal Piracy
lines: Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to an opponent, you may draw a card.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, you may draw a card.
differences: Text A triggers on combat damage dealt to an opponent; Text B triggers on combat damage dealt to any player, which would include the controller of the creature if it dealt combat damage to its own controller.

cards.name: Gifts Ungiven
lines: Search your library for up to four cards with different names and reveal them. Target opponent chooses two of those cards. Put the chosen cards into your graveyard and the rest into your hand. Then shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The target opponent choosing two of the searched cards to go to the graveyard while the rest go to hand has no schema form; searchLibrary has no opponent choice that splits the found cards between zones.

cards.name: Natural Order
lines: Search your library for a green creature card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
cards.backTranslation: Search your library for a green creature card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
differences: Text A includes the spell's additional cost to sacrifice a green creature; Text B omits it, so B's spell can be cast without sacrificing a green creature.

cards.name: Planar Genesis
lines: Look at the top four cards of your library. You may put a land card from among them onto the battlefield tapped. If you don't, put a card from among them into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The look-at-top-four step offers one choice only (a land onto the battlefield tapped), and the schema cannot express the fallback 'if you don't, put a card from among them into your hand' as a second destination for the same looked-at cards.

cards.name: Horizon of Progress
lines: {3}, {T}: You may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
cards.inexpressibleReason: handToBattlefield can put a land card from hand onto the battlefield but has no tapped option, and the line requires it to enter tapped.

cards.name: Patriarch's Bidding
lines: Each player chooses a creature type. Each player returns all creature cards of a type chosen this way from their graveyard to the battlefield.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Each player chooses a creature type and then returns that type's creature cards from their own graveyard, and no op lets each player pick a type and then return matching graveyard creatures (the only type choices are the permanent's entersChoosingOption or a per-permanent chosen type).

cards.name: Final Fortune
lines: Take an extra turn after this one. At the beginning of that turn's end step, you lose the game.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect op makes a player lose the game, so the end-step loss of Final Fortune cannot be stated.

cards.name: Tortured Existence
lines: {B}, Discard a creature card: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The discard cost "Discard a creature card" cannot be expressed: the discardCard cost has only a count and no card filter, so it cannot require a creature card.

cards.name: World Shaper
lines: When this creature dies, return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
cards.inexpressibleReason: graveyardToBattlefieldEach has no tapped option, so 'return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped' cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Adagia, Windswept Bastion
lines: 12+ | {3}{W}, {T}: Create a token that's a copy of target artifact or enchantment you control, except it's legendary. Activate only as a sorcery.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The token copy must be made legendary, but createTokenCopyOf can only remove legendary (exceptNonLegendary) and cannot add the legendary supertype.

cards.name: Hydroid Krasis
lines: When you cast this spell, you gain half X life and draw half X cards. Round down each time.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no Value for half of X rounded down (Value offers only times, plus and negate), so 'gain half X life and draw half X cards' cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Creeping Bloodsucker
lines: At the beginning of your upkeep, this creature deals 1 damage to each opponent. You gain life equal to the damage dealt this way.
cards.inexpressibleReason: "You gain life equal to the damage dealt this way" has no reference to the damage an untargeted each-opponent damage effect dealt, and gainLifeEqualToLifeLostThisWay reads life loss rather than damage.

cards.name: Rhox Faithmender
lines: If you would gain life, you gain twice that much life instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no life-gain replacement effect (the only replacement rule statics double damage, tokens, or counters), so "if you would gain life, you gain twice that much life instead" cannot be stated.

cards.name: Eerie Ultimatum
lines: Return any number of permanent cards with different names from your graveyard to the battlefield.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The line returns any number of permanent cards with different names from the graveyard, but graveyardToBattlefieldEach returns every matching card and no op lets the controller choose any number subject to a distinct-names constraint.

cards.name: Corpsejack Menace
lines: If one or more +1/+1 counters would be put on a creature you control, twice that many +1/+1 counters are put on it instead.
cards.backTranslation: If one or more +1/+1 counters would be put on a creature you control, twice that many +1/+1 counters are put on that creature instead.

cards.name: Odric, Lunarch Marshal
lines: At the beginning of each combat, creatures you control gain first strike until end of turn if a creature you control has first strike. The same is true for flying, deathtouch, double strike, haste, hexproof, indestructible, lifelink, menace, reach, skulk, trample, and vigilance.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Each keyword clause needs the condition "a creature you control has that keyword", but the keyword-presence selector (hasKeyword) is event-only in the schema, so the condition cannot be read at the beginning of combat.

cards.name: Archfiend of Depravity
lines: At the beginning of each opponent's end step, that player chooses up to two creatures they control, then sacrifices the rest.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect lets the affected player choose up to two creatures to keep and sacrifice the rest; the schema only has sacrifice-all or fixed-count sacrifice.

cards.name: Relentless Assault
lines: Untap all creatures that attacked this turn. After this main phase, there is an additional combat phase followed by an additional main phase.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The untap selector for "creatures that attacked this turn" would need attackedThisTurn, which the schema marks event-only and so cannot be trusted when read by a resolving sorcery.

cards.name: Stitch Together
lines: Return that card from your graveyard to the battlefield instead if there are seven or more cards in your graveyard.
cards.backTranslation: Target creature card in your graveyard. If there are seven or more cards in your graveyard, put that card onto the battlefield. Otherwise, return that card to your hand.

cards.name: Awakening Zone
lines: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token. It has "Sacrifice this token: Add {C}."
cards.backTranslation: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token. It has "Sacrifice this creature: Add {C}."

cards.name: Fomori Vault
lines: {3}, {T}, Discard a card: Look at the top X cards of your library, where X is the number of artifacts you control. Put one of those cards into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
cards.inexpressibleReason: lookAtTopN takes a fixed number of cards, but the line looks at the top X cards where X is the number of artifacts you control.

cards.name: Ophidian Eye
lines: Whenever enchanted creature deals damage to an opponent, you may draw a card.
validatorIssues: override.def.triggers[0].trigger.subject: opponent damage currently supports only the damaging source's own ability
cards.inexpressibleReason: dealsDamageToOpponent only supports the source's own ability (subject self), so "whenever enchanted creature deals damage to an opponent" with the Aura's controller drawing has no form.

cards.name: Cultivator Colossus
lines: When this creature enters, you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped. If you do, draw a card and repeat this process.
cards.inexpressibleReason: handToBattlefield cannot put the land onto the battlefield tapped, and there is no 'if you do, draw a card and repeat this process' loop.

cards.name: Desynchronization
lines: Return each nonland permanent that's not historic to its owner's hand.
cards.backTranslation: Return each nonland permanent on the battlefield that is not an artifact, is not legendary, and is not a Saga to its owner's hand.

cards.name: Goblin Welder
lines: {T}: Choose target artifact a player controls and target artifact card in that player's graveyard. If both targets are still legal as this ability resolves, that player simultaneously sacrifices the artifact and returns the artifact card to the battlefield.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The second target must be an artifact card in the graveyard of the controller of the first target, but graveyardOwnerSlot only names an earlier player target slot, not the controller of a permanent target.

cards.name: Malcolm, Alluring Scoundrel
lines: Whenever ~ deals combat damage to a player, put a chorus counter on it. Draw a card, then discard a card. If there are four or more chorus counters on ~, you may cast the discarded card without paying its mana cost.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The free cast of the discarded card when four or more chorus counters are on Malcolm has no reference to the discarded card, since the discard op does not name it.

cards.name: Losheel, Clockwork Scholar
lines: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to attacking artifact creatures you control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no continuous prevention of combat damage limited to attacking artifact creatures you control; the only prevention forms are for all combat damage or for the source itself.

cards.name: Felidar Sovereign
lines: At the beginning of your upkeep, if you have 40 or more life, you win the game.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The upkeep trigger's life check could be written as a compareValues condition, but no effect makes its controller win the game.

cards.name: The Gaffer
lines: At the beginning of each end step, if you gained 3 or more life this turn, draw a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No Value or Condition reads how much life you gained this turn, so the intervening-if "gained 3 or more life this turn" cannot be stated.

cards.name: Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath
lines: When ~ enters, sacrifice it unless it escaped.
cards.backTranslation: When this creature enters, if it escaped, nothing happens. Otherwise, sacrifice it.

cards.name: Unmarked Grave
lines: Search your library for a nonlegendary card, put that card into your graveyard, then shuffle.
cards.backTranslation: Search your library for a card that is not legendary and put it into your graveyard. Then shuffle.

cards.name: Simulacrum Synthesizer
lines: Whenever another artifact you control with mana value 3 or greater enters, create a 0/0 colorless Construct artifact creature token with "~ gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control."
cards.backTranslation: Whenever another artifact you control with mana value 3 or greater enters, create a 0/0 colorless artifact creature token named Construct with "This creature gets +X/+X, where X is the number of artifacts you control."

cards.name: Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd
lines: Whenever ~ attacks, exile up to one other target nonland permanent. At the beginning of the next end step, return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control. If it entered under your control, put a +1/+1 counter on ~.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The "if it entered under your control, put a +1/+1 counter on Phelia" check reads who controls the card when it returns, and exileTargetReturnAtNextEndStep returns it only under its owner with no condition on the returned card's controller.

cards.name: Replicating Ring
lines: At the beginning of your upkeep, put a night counter on this artifact. Then if it has eight or more night counters on it, remove all of them and create eight colorless snow artifact tokens named Replicated Ring with "{T}: Add one mana of any color."
cards.backTranslation:
At the beginning of your upkeep, put a night counter on this.
If this has eight or more night counters on it, remove all night counters from it and create eight tokens. Each token is a snow artifact named Replicated Ring with "{T}: Add one mana of any color among white, blue, black, red, and green."

cards.name: Sting, the Glinting Dagger
lines: Equipped creature has first strike as long as it's blocking or blocked by a Goblin or Orc.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No Condition can say 'as long as it is blocking or blocked by a Goblin or Orc', so the conditional first strike cannot be modeled.

cards.name: Smuggler's Share
lines: At the beginning of each end step, draw a card for each opponent who drew two or more cards this turn, then create a Treasure token for each opponent who had two or more lands enter the battlefield under their control this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Each end step needs a per-opponent count of opponents who drew two or more cards this turn and a per-opponent count of those with two or more lands entering this turn, and no value or condition counts opponents by draw or land-entry tallies (drawForOpponentsWithSmallHands only reads hand size).

cards.name: Thran Power Suit
lines: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 for each Aura and Equipment attached to it and has ward {2}.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No Value counts the Equipment attached to the equipped creature (aurasAttachedToSource counts only Auras), so '+1/+1 for each Aura and Equipment attached to it' cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Illusionist's Bracers
lines: Whenever an ability of equipped creature is activated, if it isn't a mana ability, copy that ability. You may choose new targets for the copy.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The activatesAbility trigger has no source filter, so it cannot restrict to abilities of the equipped creature.

cards.name: Wild-Magic Sorcerer
lines: The first spell you cast from exile each turn has cascade.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No op grants cascade to a spell on the stack, and castsSpell castFrom can only say 'notHand', which also covers graveyard, command zone and library casts rather than exile only.

cards.name: Loyal Warhound
lines: When this creature enters, if an opponent controls more lands than you, search your library for a basic Plains card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
cards.backTranslation: When this creature enters, if an opponent controls more lands than you, search your library for a basic Plains card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.

cards.name: Return to Dust
lines: Exile target artifact or enchantment. If you cast this spell during your main phase, you may exile up to one other target artifact or enchantment.
validatorIssues: override.def.spellAbility.targets[1].differentFromSlots: another target requires earlier ordinary slots
cards.inexpressibleReason: A second "up to one other target" slot that exists only when cast during your main phase cannot be said: variable-count slots cannot exclude the first target (differentFromSlots is ordinary-only) and targets cannot be conditional on cast timing.

cards.name: Renewed Solidarity
lines: At the beginning of your end step, for each token you control of the chosen type that entered this turn, create a token that's a copy of it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: createTokenCopyOf copies one fixed referent, so 'for each token you control of the chosen type that entered this turn, create a copy of it' over several different tokens cannot be stated.

cards.name: Teysa Karlov
lines: If a creature dying causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No trigger-doubling static is limited to triggers caused by a creature dying; triggerAdditionalTime carries no event condition, so it would also double the permanent's other triggers.

cards.name: Traverse the Outlands
lines: Search your library for up to X basic land cards, where X is the greatest power among creatures you control. Put those cards onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
cards.backTranslation: Search your library for a number of basic land cards equal to the greatest power among creatures you control. You may find fewer. Put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.

cards.name: Run Away Together
lines: Choose two target creatures controlled by different players. Return those creatures to their owners' hands.

cards.name: Oversold Cemetery
lines: At the beginning of your upkeep, if you have four or more creature cards in your graveyard, you may return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
cards.backTranslation: At the beginning of your upkeep, if there are four or more creature cards in your graveyard, you may target a creature card in your graveyard. If you do, return that card to your hand.

cards.name: Woe Strider
lines: ~ escapes with two +1/+1 counters on it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: 'Escapes with two +1/+1 counters on it' needs counters conditional on the escape cast; entersWithCounters is unconditional, and a trigger on escape would put the counters on after entering rather than as it enters.

cards.name: Blood Money
lines: Destroy all creatures. For each nontoken creature destroyed this way, you create a tapped Treasure token.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The Treasure count equals the number of nontoken creatures destroyed this way, and no Value counts that set; creaturesDiedThisTurn includes tokens and every death this turn.

cards.name: Allosaurus Shepherd
lines: {4}{G}{G}: Until end of turn, each Elf creature you control has base power and toughness 5/5 and becomes a Dinosaur in addition to its other creature types.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No until-end-of-turn effect sets base power and toughness to 5/5 and adds a creature type to each Elf you control at once (becomeCreatureUntilEot takes a single target).

cards.name: Crypt of Agadeem
lines: {2}, {T}: Add {B} for each black creature card in your graveyard.
validatorIssues: override.def.manaAbilities[0].amount: mana amount a mana ability cannot evaluate
cards.inexpressibleReason: A mana ability's amount cannot count cards in a graveyard by characteristic (countCardsInZone is not evaluable for a mana ability).

cards.name: Extraplanar Lens
lines: Whenever a land with the same name as the exiled card is tapped for mana, its controller adds one mana of any type that land produced.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No selector matches lands with the same name as the card exiled with this artifact (selector name takes a fixed string, and the exiled card is not stored as a name).

cards.name: Gingerbrute
lines: {1}: ~ can't be blocked this turn except by creatures with haste.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect or static says 'can't be blocked this turn except by creatures with haste' (blocker-restricted evasion); cantBeBlockedUntilEot is unconditional.

cards.name: Ondu Spiritdancer
lines: Whenever an enchantment you control enters, you may create a token that's a copy of it. Do this only once each turn.
cards.backTranslation: Once each turn, when a permanent you control that is an enchantment enters, you may create a token that is a copy of that permanent.

cards.name: Reforge the Soul
lines: Miracle {1}{R}
cards.inexpressibleReason: Miracle {1}{R} is a draw-triggered alternative cost with a first-card-drawn-this-turn condition, and the schema has no miracle keyword, draw-reveal cast trigger, or first-draw-this-turn condition to express it.

cards.name: Sword of Truth and Justice
lines: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control, then proliferate.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, put a +1/+1 counter on a creature of your choice. Then proliferate.
differences: Text A puts the +1/+1 counter on a creature you control; Text B puts it on a creature of the controller's choice with no requirement that it be one you control.

cards.name: Moonsilver Key
lines: {1}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Search your library for an artifact card with a mana ability or a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The search filter 'artifact card with a mana ability' has no selector leaf for having a mana ability.

cards.name: Tetsuko Umezawa, Fugitive
lines: Creatures you control with power or toughness 1 or less can't be blocked.
cards.inexpressibleReason: powerAtMost is event-only and no static selector reads power or toughness 1 or less, so 'power or toughness 1 or less' cannot be stated for a continuous effect.

cards.name: Profane Tutor
lines: Suspend 2—{1}{B}
cards.inexpressibleReason: Suspend is not a keyword or alternative cast in the schema: no way to exile the card with time counters, count them down at upkeep, and cast it free when the last is removed.

cards.name: Obscura Storefront
lines: When this land enters, sacrifice it. When you do, search your library for a basic Plains, Island, or Swamp card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle and you gain 1 life.

cards.name: Gift of the Viper
lines: Put a +1/+1 counter, a reach counter, and a deathtouch counter on target creature. Untap it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The reach and deathtouch counters grant those keywords (CR 122.1b), and the schema has no effect that makes a named counter kind grant a keyword.

cards.name: Molten Duplication
lines: Create a token that's a copy of target artifact or creature you control, except it's an artifact in addition to its other types. It gains haste until end of turn. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
cards.backTranslation: Target artifact or creature you control. Create a token that's a copy of that permanent, except it's an artifact in addition to its other types and it has haste. Sacrifice that token at the beginning of the end step.

cards.name: Proft's Eidetic Memory
lines: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you've drawn more than one card this turn, put X +1/+1 counters on target creature you control, where X is the number of cards you've drawn this turn minus one.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no condition or value for the number of cards you have drawn this turn, so neither the "if you've drawn more than one card this turn" intervening-if nor the X equal to that count minus one can be stated.

cards.name: Susur Secundi, Void Altar
lines: 12+ | {1}{B}, {T}, Pay 2 life, Sacrifice a creature: Draw cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power. Activate only as a sorcery.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The ability's cost sacrifices a creature and draws cards equal to that creature's power, but no value captures the power of a creature sacrificed as a cost (stationPower covers only the Station tap cost).

cards.name: Flashback
lines: Target instant or sorcery card in your graveyard gains flashback until end of turn. The flashback cost is equal to its mana cost.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect grants a card in the graveyard an alternative flashback cast equal to its mana cost; grantAbilityUntilEot grants abilities, not alternativeCasts.

cards.name: Intruder Alarm
lines: Creatures don't untap during their controllers' untap steps.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No static stops all creatures from untapping during their controllers' untap steps, since doesntUntapDuringUntapStep applies only to the source.

cards.name: Impulsive Pilferer
lines: Encore {3}{R}
cards.inexpressibleReason: Encore is not a keyword or alternative cast in the schema: no way to exile the card from the graveyard and create a hasty token copy per opponent that attacks them and is sacrificed at the next end step.

cards.name: Painful Truths
lines: You draw X cards and lose X life, where X is the number of colors of mana spent to cast this spell.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No value counts the colors of mana spent to cast this spell (converge); the schema's color-count values read permanents or the triggering spell, not this spell's payment.

cards.name: Tomb of the Spirit Dragon
lines: {2}, {T}: You gain 1 life for each colorless creature you control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The Selector color leaf takes only W, U, B, R or G, so there is no way to count colorless creatures.

cards.name: Alesha, Who Laughs at Fate
lines: At the beginning of your end step, if you attacked this turn, return target creature card with mana value less than or equal to ~'s power from your graveyard to the battlefield.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No condition reads whether you attacked this turn, and the return's mana value limit cannot be compared to Alesha's power (manaValueAtMost takes a fixed number).

cards.name: Vaultborn Tyrant
lines: When this creature dies, if it's not a token, create a token that's a copy of it, except it's an artifact in addition to its other types.
cards.backTranslation: When this dies, if it wasn't a token, create a token that's a copy of it, except it's an artifact in addition to its other types.

cards.name: Seize the Spotlight
lines: Each opponent chooses fame or fortune. For each player who chose fame, gain control of a creature that player controls until end of turn. Untap those creatures and they gain haste until end of turn. For each player who chose fortune, you draw a card and create a Treasure token.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect lets each opponent choose fame or fortune and then branches per chosen player (masterOfCeremonies is a single printed card's op, not a general choice).

cards.name: Supernatural Stamina
lines: Until end of turn, target creature gets +2/+0 and gains "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control."
cards.backTranslation:
Target creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
That creature gains "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped." until end of turn.

cards.name: Timely Ward
lines: You may cast this spell as though it had flash if it targets a commander.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No permission lets this spell be cast with flash only when it targets a commander; the keyword flash is unconditional and an alternative cast would change the cost.

cards.name: Army of the Damned
lines: Create thirteen tapped 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens.
cards.backTranslation: Create thirteen tapped 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens.

cards.name: Ancient Brass Dragon
lines: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, roll a d20. When you do, put any number of target creature cards with total mana value X or less from graveyards onto the battlefield under your control, where X is the result.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The line requires rolling a d20 and a 'when you do' reflexive put of creature cards with total mana value X from graveyards, and the schema has no die roll.

cards.name: Adaptive Automaton
lines: ~ is the chosen type in addition to its other types.
cards.backTranslation: The creature type chosen for this is added to its other creature types.

cards.name: Satyr Wayfinder
lines: When this creature enters, reveal the top four cards of your library. You may put a land card from among them into your hand. Put the rest into your graveyard.
cards.backTranslation: When this enters, look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal a land card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest into your graveyard.

cards.name: Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger
lines: Whenever an opponent taps a land for mana, that land doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no effect that keeps another player's tapped land from untapping during its controller's next untap step (doesntUntapDuringUntapStep applies only to the card itself).

cards.name: Hit the Mother Lode
lines: Discover 10. If the discovered card's mana value is less than 10, create a number of tapped Treasure tokens equal to the difference.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The Treasure count is 10 minus the discovered card's mana value, and no Value reads the mana value of the card that discover found.

cards.name: Extravagant Replication
lines: At the beginning of your upkeep, create a token that's a copy of another target nonland permanent you control.
cards.backTranslation: At the beginning of your upkeep, create a token that's a copy of target another nonland permanent you control.

cards.name: Grateful Apparition
lines: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player or planeswalker, proliferate.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The combat damage trigger only covers damage to a player; the schema has no trigger for combat damage dealt to a planeswalker, so the 'or planeswalker' half cannot be said.

cards.name: Urabrask the Hidden
lines: Creatures your opponents control enter tapped.
cards.backTranslation: Creatures your opponents control enter the battlefield tapped.

cards.name: Brave the Sands
lines: Each creature you control can block an additional creature each combat.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no static that lets creatures you control block an additional creature each combat (minBlockers and cantBlockAlone do not raise a blocking limit).

cards.name: Insurrection
lines: Untap all creatures and gain control of them until end of turn. They gain haste until end of turn.
cards.backTranslation: Gain control of each creature until end of turn. Untap those creatures. They gain haste.
differences: Text B's haste ('They gain haste.') has no duration and lasts indefinitely; Text A's haste lasts only until end of turn

cards.name: Goldlust Triad
lines: Myriad
cards.inexpressibleReason: Myriad (optional tapped-and-attacking token copies per opponent, exiled at end of combat) has no schema form: createTokenForEachOpponent has no 'you may' or exile-at-end-of-combat option, and myriad is not a keyword.

cards.name: Claim Jumper
lines: When this creature enters, if an opponent controls more lands than you, you may search your library for a Plains card and put it onto the battlefield tapped. Then if an opponent controls more lands than you, repeat this process once. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The repeated second search is separately optional and gated by its own land-count check, and the shuffle happens only if a search was made; the schema has no per-search optional repeat or conditional shuffle.

cards.name: Massacre Girl
lines: When ~ enters, each other creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn. Whenever a creature dies this turn, each creature other than ~ gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The delayed trigger for 'whenever a creature dies this turn' takes a bare event name with no subject selector, so it cannot say which creatures' deaths fire it.

cards.name: Get Lost
lines: Destroy target creature, enchantment, or planeswalker. Its controller creates two Map tokens.

cards.name: Power Fist
lines: Equipped creature has trample and "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, put that many +1/+1 counters on it."
cards.backTranslation:
Enchanted creature has trample.
Enchanted creature has "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature for each point of damage dealt."
differences: Text A grants the effects to the equipped creature (equipment attachment); Text B refers to the enchanted creature (aura attachment), which describes a different attachment relationship and does not match an Equip-based permanent.

cards.name: Colossal Grave-Reaver
lines: Whenever one or more creature cards are put into your graveyard from your library, put one of them onto the battlefield.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No trigger watches creature cards moving from the library to the graveyard, so 'one or more creature cards are put into your graveyard from your library' has no trigger event.

cards.name: Mana Reflection
lines: If you tap a permanent for mana, it produces twice as much of that mana instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: A manaActivationRider adds one mana of a produced type or fixed units, not a second copy of whatever the permanent produced, so it would undercount multi-unit permanents.

cards.name: Containment Construct
lines: Whenever you discard a card, you may exile that card from your graveyard. If you do, you may play that card this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect exiles the discarded card from the graveyard and gives its controller permission to play it this turn (exileGraveyardEventCard has no play permission, and exileTopNPlayableUntilEot works only from the top of the library).

cards.name: Tormod's Crypt
lines: {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Exile target player's graveyard.
cards.backTranslation: {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Exile target player's graveyard.

cards.name: Terrain Generator
lines: {2}, {T}: You may put a basic land card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The handToBattlefield effect cannot put the land onto the battlefield tapped; it has no tapped option.

cards.name: Bartolomé del Presidio
lines: Sacrifice another creature or artifact: Put a +1/+1 counter on ~.
cards.backTranslation: Sacrifice another creature or artifact you control: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. Activate only at any time.

cards.name: White Sun's Twilight
lines: You gain X life. Create X 1/1 colorless Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens with toxic 1 and "~ can't block." If X is 5 or more, destroy all other creatures.
cards.inexpressibleReason: TokenSpec has no toxic field and no plain "this token can't block" rule static, so the Phyrexian Mite tokens cannot be given toxic 1 and can't block.

cards.name: Cycle of Renewal
lines: Sacrifice a land. Search your library for up to two basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
cards.backTranslation: Sacrifice a land you control. Then search your library for two basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
differences: Text A searches for up to two basic land cards (the player may find zero or one); Text B says search for two basic land cards, which is mandatory and exact.

cards.name: Lazotep Quarry
lines: {X}{2}, {T}, Sacrifice a Desert: Exile target creature card with mana value X from your graveyard. Create a token that's a copy of it, except it's a 4/4 black Zombie. Activate only as a sorcery.
cards.inexpressibleReason: createTokenCopyOf has power and toughness overrides but no color override, so the copy 'except it's a 4/4 black Zombie' cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Knuckles the Echidna
lines: Treasure Hunter — At the beginning of your upkeep, if you control thirty or more artifacts, you win the game.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no effect that makes a player win the game, so "you win the game" cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Hero's Blade
lines: Whenever a legendary creature you control enters, you may attach this Equipment to it.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever a legendary creature you control enters, you may attach this to that creature.

cards.name: Threefold Thunderhulk

cards.backTranslation:
When this creature enters, create a number of 1/1 colorless Gnome artifact creature tokens equal to this creature's power.
Whenever this creature attacks, create a number of 1/1 colorless Gnome artifact creature tokens equal to this creature's power.

cards.name: Dictate of Kruphix
lines: At the beginning of each player's draw step, that player draws an additional card.
cards.backTranslation: At the beginning of each player's draw step, that player draws a card.
differences: Text A has the player draw an additional card at the beginning of each player's draw step; Text B has that player draw only a card, so the extra draw is missing.

lines: At the beginning of each end step, if you created a token this turn, draw a card.
cards.backTranslation: At the beginning of each end step, if a token was created this turn, draw a card.
differences: Text A checks for a token you created this turn (you control the trigger condition); Text B checks for a token created by anyone this turn, so the draw can happen when an opponent created a token.

cards.inexpressibleReason: castsSpell's castFrom can only say 'graveyard', 'hand' or 'notHand', so 'a spell from exile' cannot be stated exactly (notHand also matches graveyard, library and command zone casts).

cards.name: Loran's Escape

Target artifact or creature gains hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.

cards.name: Fists of Flame
lines: Draw a card. Until end of turn, target creature gains trample and gets +1/+0 for each card you've drawn this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No Value counts the cards you have drawn this turn, so '+1/+0 for each card you've drawn this turn' cannot be stated.

cards.name: Tree of Perdition

cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect exchanges a player's life total with this creature's toughness.

cards.name: Kami of the Crescent Moon
lines: At the beginning of each player's draw step, that player draws an additional card.
cards.backTranslation: At the beginning of each player's draw step, that player draws a card.
differences: Text A makes that player draw an additional card at the beginning of each player's draw step; Text B has that player draw a card, which is the normal draw and not an extra one.

cards.name: Divine Visitation
lines: If one or more creature tokens would be created under your control, that many 4/4 white Angel creature tokens with flying and vigilance are created instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The replacement swaps each creature token for a 4/4 Angel (the original tokens are never created), but tokenCreationReplacement only adds an extra token and tokenCountMultiplier only multiplies the count, so no IR replaces the token being created.

cards.name: Search for Tomorrow
lines: Suspend 2—{G}
cards.inexpressibleReason: Suspend (exile with time counters, cast when the last is removed) has no mechanic in the schema.

cards.name: The Locust God
lines: When ~ dies, return it to its owner's hand at the beginning of the next end step.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no return-to-hand effect delayed to the beginning of the next end step: returnDepartedSourceToHand has no delay option (only the to-battlefield form does).

cards.name: Phyrexian Obliterator
lines: Whenever a source deals damage to this creature, that source's controller sacrifices that many permanents of their choice.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema does not establish that the event player of a dealtDamage trigger is the damage source's controller, nor that damageDealt is set for it, so "that source's controller sacrifices that many permanents" cannot be stated safely.

cards.name: Archetype of Imagination
lines: Creatures your opponents control lose flying and can't have or gain flying.
cards.backTranslation: Creatures your opponents control can't have flying.
differences: Text A makes creatures your opponents control lose flying, removing flying they already have; Text B only says they can't have flying and does not remove existing flying.

cards.name: Cryptbreaker
lines: Tap three untapped Zombies you control: You draw a card and lose 1 life.
cards.backTranslation: Tap three Zombies (this creature can be one of them): You draw a card and you lose 1 life.
differences: Text A requires three untapped Zombies you control; Text B requires three Zombies with no requirement that they be untapped or that you control them, so tapped Zombies and opponents' Zombies would qualify.

cards.name: Mutavault
lines: {1}: ~ becomes a 2/2 creature with all creature types until end of turn. It's still a land.
cards.inexpressibleReason: becomeCreatureUntilEot takes an explicit subtype list and cannot state 'with all creature types'.

cards.name: As Foretold
lines: Once each turn, you may pay {0} rather than pay the mana cost for a spell you cast with mana value X or less, where X is the number of time counters on this enchantment.
cards.inexpressibleReason: An alternative cost of {0} that is limited to once each turn and to spells whose mana value is at most this enchantment's time counters has no schema form: alternativeCasts has no per-turn limit and no condition compares the cast spell's mana value to a source counter.

cards.name: Bloodline Pretender
lines: Whenever another creature you control of the chosen type enters, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever another creature you control of the chosen creature type enters, put a +1/+1 counter on this.

cards.name: Bitterthorn, Nissa's Animus
lines: Living weapon
cards.backTranslation: When this enters, create a 0/0 black Phyrexian Germ creature token. Attach this to the created token.

cards.name: Tannuk, Memorial Ensign

cards.backTranslation: Whenever a land you control enters, count how many times this ability has resolved this turn, including this time. If that number is 2, each opponent takes 1 damage and you draw a card. Otherwise, each opponent takes 1 damage.

cards.name: For the Common Good
lines: Create X tokens that are copies of target token you control. Then tokens you control gain indestructible until your next turn. You gain 1 life for each token you control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: grantKeywordEachUntilEot lasts only until end of turn, and the schema has no duration for granting indestructible until your next turn to the tokens you control.

cards.name: Defense Grid
lines: Each spell costs {3} more to cast except during its controller's turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No rule static adds cost to all spells: costReduction only lowers cost, and opponentNonHandSpellCostIncrease covers only opponents' non-hand spells, so spells of the controller and the timing exception cannot be stated.

cards.name: Black Sun's Zenith
lines: Put X -1/-1 counters on each creature. Shuffle ~ into its owner's library.
cards.backTranslation: Put X -1/-1 counters on each creature. Then shuffle this spell into its owner's library.

cards.name: Homunculus Horde
lines: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, create a token that's a copy of this creature.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, create a token that's a copy of this creature.

cards.name: Hostage Taker
lines: When this creature enters, exile another target creature or artifact until this creature leaves the battlefield. You may cast that card for as long as it remains exiled, and mana of any type can be spent to cast that spell.
cards.inexpressibleReason: exileUntilSourceLeaves exiles the target, but the schema has no permission that lets its controller cast the exiled card for as long as it remains exiled with mana of any type spendable.

cards.name: Thirst for Knowledge
lines: Draw three cards. Then discard two cards unless you discard an artifact card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The discard cannot be conditioned on discarding an artifact card: the discard effect has no card filter and no choice between an artifact discard and a two-card discard.

cards.name: Inkmoth Nexus
lines: {1}: ~ becomes a 1/1 Phyrexian Blinkmoth artifact creature with flying and infect until end of turn. It's still a land.
cards.inexpressibleReason: becomeCreatureUntilEot has no field to add the Artifact type alongside Creature (replaceTypes would drop Land), so 'artifact creature' cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Abundance
lines: If you would draw a card, you may instead choose land or nonland and reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a card of the chosen kind. Put that card into your hand and put all other cards revealed this way on the bottom of your library in any order.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no draw-replacement effect that lets the controller choose land or nonland and then reveal down to a card of that kind, with the other revealed cards bottomed.

cards.name: Teferi's Puzzle Box
lines: At the beginning of each player's draw step, that player puts the cards in their hand on the bottom of their library in any order, then draws that many cards.
cards.inexpressibleReason: putAnyFromHandOnBottomThenDraw lets the player choose any number of cards, but the card puts every card in that player's hand on the bottom of the library.

cards.name: Ob Nixilis, the Fallen
lines: Whenever a land you control enters, you may have target player lose 3 life. If you do, put three +1/+1 counters on ~.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever a land you control enters, you may have target player lose 3 life and put three +1/+1 counters on this.

cards.name: Temur Sabertooth
lines: {1}{G}: You may return another creature you control to its owner's hand. If you do, this creature gains indestructible until end of turn.

cards.backTranslation: Whenever equipped creature attacks, look at the top card of your library. You may put that card onto the battlefield tapped if it's a land. Put the rest on top of your library in any order.

cards.name: Entity Tracker
lines: Eerie — Whenever an enchantment you control enters and whenever you fully unlock a Room, draw a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no trigger for 'whenever you fully unlock a Room', so the second half of the Eerie line cannot be modeled.

cards.name: Wrathful Red Dragon
lines: Whenever a Dragon you control is dealt damage, it deals that much damage to any target that isn't a Dragon.
validatorIssues: override.def.triggers[0].targets[0]: target filter is not implemented for every member of this domain
cards.inexpressibleReason: An anyTarget slot only supports a filter equal to not-commander, so "any target that isn't a Dragon" cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Pact of the Serpent
lines: Choose a creature type. Target player draws X cards and loses X life, where X is the number of creatures they control of the chosen type.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no resolution-time creature type choice for a spell, so 'choose a creature type' and the count of the target player's creatures of that chosen type cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Sword of Light and Shadow
lines: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, you gain 3 life and you may return up to one target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The "up to one target creature card from your graveyard" return cannot be expressed alongside the unconditional 3 life gain: graveyardToHand takes a single target and no graveyard-slot op accepts a zero-or-one choice.

cards.name: Season of Growth
lines: Whenever you cast a spell that targets a creature you control, draw a card.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever you cast a creature spell, draw a card.
differences: Text A triggers only when you cast a spell that targets a creature you control; Text B triggers on any creature spell cast, whether or not it targets anything.

cards.name: Rooftop Storm
lines: You may pay {0} rather than pay the mana cost for Zombie creature spells you cast.
cards.inexpressibleReason: costReduction only lowers cost by a fixed or Value amount; it cannot set a Zombie creature spell's total cost to {0} as an alternative payment.

cards.name: Song of Totentanz
lines: Create X 1/1 black Rat creature tokens with "~ can't block." Creatures you control gain haste until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: A token spec has no printed cantBlock characteristic (only the card-level cantBlock field has one), and no documented token ruleStatic states 'this token can't block' exactly.

cards.name: Invert Polarity
lines: Choose target spell, then flip a coin. If you win the flip, gain control of that spell and you may choose new targets for it. If you lose the flip, counter that spell.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no effect that gains control of a spell on the stack, so 'gain control of that spell' cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Mina and Denn, Wildborn
lines: {R}{G}, Return a land you control to its owner's hand: Target creature gains trample until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The activation cost 'Return a land you control to its owner's hand' has no AbilityCost kind in the schema.

cards.name: Hermit Druid
lines: {G}, {T}: Reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a basic land card. Put that card into your hand and all other cards revealed this way into your graveyard.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no reveal-until-basic-land effect (revealUntilAura is limited to Auras), so revealing cards until a basic land and putting the rest into the graveyard cannot be stated.

cards.name: Darksteel Colossus
lines: If ~ would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, reveal ~ and shuffle it into its owner's library instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The graveyard replacement must shuffle the card into its owner's library; graveyardToExile only exiles, and no replacement op puts the card into the library.

cards.name: Delay
lines: Counter target spell. If the spell is countered this way, exile it with three time counters on it instead of putting it into its owner's graveyard. If it doesn't have suspend, it gains suspend.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Exiling the countered spell with three time counters on it, and giving it suspend when it lacks suspend, has no effect form (the counter op only offers a plain exile).

cards.name: Dragonhawk, Fate's Tempest
lines: Whenever ~ enters or attacks, exile the top X cards of your library, where X is the number of creatures you control with power 4 or greater. You may play those cards until your next end step. At the beginning of your next end step, ~ deals 2 damage to each opponent for each of those cards that are still exiled.
cards.inexpressibleReason: exileTopNPlayableUntilEot lets cards be cast only until end of turn, not 'play until your next end step', and no delayed damage can count the cards still exiled from that exile.

cards.name: Sphinx of the Second Sun
lines: At the beginning of each of your postcombat main phases, there is an additional beginning phase after this phase.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect creates an additional beginning phase (untap, upkeep and draw steps) after the postcombat main phase.

cards.name: Spiteful Banditry
lines: Whenever one or more creatures your opponents control die, you create a Treasure token. This ability triggers only once each turn.
cards.backTranslation: Once each turn, whenever one or more creatures your opponents control die, create a Treasure token. That token has "{T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add one mana of your choice of {W}, {U}, {B}, {R}, or {G}."

cards.name: Poison Dart Frog
lines: {2}: ~ gains deathtouch until end of turn.
cards.backTranslation: {2}: This gains deathtouch until end of turn.

cards.name: Umbral Mantle
lines: Equipped creature has "{3}, {Q}: ~ gets +2/+2 until end of turn."
cards.inexpressibleReason: The granted ability's {Q} (untap symbol) cost has no AbilityCost form; the cost list offers only tap, not untap.

cards.name: Blacksmith's Skill
lines: Target permanent gains hexproof and indestructible until end of turn. If it's an artifact creature, it gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
cards.backTranslation:
Target permanent gains hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
If that permanent is an artifact creature, it gets +2/+2 until end of turn.

cards.name: Thrumming Stone
lines: Spells you cast have ripple 4.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Ripple is not among the keywords the schema can grant, and no static gives spells you cast a ripple cast trigger.

cards.name: End the Festivities
lines: ~ deals 1 damage to each opponent and each creature and planeswalker they control.
cards.backTranslation:
Each opponent takes 1 damage.
Deal 1 damage to each creature and each planeswalker that opponents control.

cards.name: Qarsi Revenant
lines: Renew — {2}{B}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Put a flying counter, a deathtouch counter, and a lifelink counter on target creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no flying, deathtouch or lifelink counter that grants the keyword: a keyword granted by a counter would need a static on this card, which would stop working when Qarsi Revenant leaves the battlefield, while the counters must keep the keywords.

cards.name: Starwinder
lines: Warp {2}{U}{U}
cards.inexpressibleReason: Warp (cast from hand for the warp cost, exile at the next end step, then recast from exile on a later turn) has no alternative-cast kind or exile-and-recast permission in the schema.

cards.name: Ancestral Mask
lines: Enchanted creature gets +2/+2 for each other enchantment on the battlefield.
cards.backTranslation: Enchanted creature gets +X/+X, where X is twice the number of other enchantments on the battlefield.

cards.name: Grafted Exoskeleton
lines: Whenever this Equipment becomes unattached from a permanent, sacrifice that permanent.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no trigger event for an Equipment becoming unattached from a permanent.

cards.name: Manabarbs
lines: Whenever a player taps a land for mana, this enchantment deals 1 damage to that player.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever a land becomes tapped for mana, this deals 1 damage to that player.
differences: Text A deals the damage to the player who tapped the land for mana ('a player taps a land for mana ... that player'). Text B's 'that player' has no antecedent in its trigger ('a land becomes tapped for mana'), so the damaged player is not defined as the tapping player; it could be read as the land's controller, which differs when another player taps a land for mana.

cards.name: Nexus of Fate
lines: If ~ would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, reveal ~ and shuffle it into its owner's library instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The replacement 'put into a graveyard from anywhere, shuffle it into its owner's library instead' has no ruleStatics form: graveyardToExile only exiles.

cards.name: Kindred Summons
lines: Choose a creature type. Reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal X creature cards of the chosen type, where X is the number of creatures you control of that type. Put those cards onto the battlefield, then shuffle the rest of the revealed cards into your library.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no resolution-time creature type choice for a spell, so 'choose a creature type' and the count of creatures of that chosen type cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Agna Qel'a
lines: ~ enters tapped unless you control a basic land.
cards.backTranslation: This enters tapped unless you control one or more basic lands.

cards.name: Wrap in Vigor
lines: Regenerate each creature you control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The regenerate effect takes a single target and there is no op that regenerates each creature you control at once.

cards.name: Assemble the Legion
lines: At the beginning of your upkeep, put a muster counter on this enchantment. Then create a 1/1 red and white Soldier creature token with haste for each muster counter on this enchantment.
cards.backTranslation: At the beginning of your upkeep, put a muster counter on this. Then create a 1/1 red and white Soldier creature token with haste for each muster counter on this.

cards.name: PuPu UFO
lines: {3}: Until end of turn, this creature's base power becomes equal to the number of Towns you control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect sets base power to a state-derived Value (count of Towns) while leaving toughness unchanged; the layer-7b and becomeCreatureUntilEot ops need a fixed toughness.

cards.name: Squee, the Immortal
lines: You may cast this card from your graveyard or from exile.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The card's own permission to cast from graveyard is expressible (castFromGraveyard), but the permission to cast it from exile has no field in the schema.

cards.name: Agent of the Iron Throne
lines: Commander creatures you own have "Whenever an artifact or creature you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, each opponent loses 1 life."
validatorIssues: answer is not valid JSON in the required shape: SyntaxError: JSON Parse error: Expected ']'
cards.backTranslation: Commander creatures you own have "Whenever an artifact or creature you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, each opponent loses 1 life."

cards.name: Slaughter the Strong
lines: Each player chooses any number of creatures they control with total power 4 or less, then sacrifices all other creatures they control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect lets each player keep any number of creatures with total power 4 or less and sacrifice the rest; the schema has no choose-by-total-power sacrifice.

cards.name: Vraska's Fall
lines: Each opponent sacrifices a creature or planeswalker of their choice and gets a poison counter.
cards.backTranslation: Each opponent sacrifices a creature or planeswalker. Each opponent gets a poison counter.

cards.name: Oblivion Sower
lines: When you cast this spell, target opponent exiles the top four cards of their library, then you may put any number of land cards that player owns from exile onto the battlefield under your control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no "when you cast this spell" self-cast trigger, and no effect exiles the opponent's top four cards and then lets you put any number of the lands they own from exile onto the battlefield under your control.

cards.name: Displace
lines: Exile up to two target creatures you control, then return those cards to the battlefield under their owner's control.
cards.backTranslation: Exile up to two target creatures you control, then return each of those creatures to the battlefield under its owner's control.

cards.name: Bloodline Bidding
lines: Choose a creature type. Return all creature cards of the chosen type from your graveyard to the battlefield.
cards.inexpressibleReason: A spell cannot choose a creature type as it resolves: chosenSubtype reads only a permanent's chosen option, so the chosen type of the mass return cannot be stated.

cards.name: Trophy Mage
lines: When this creature enters, you may search your library for an artifact card with mana value 3, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
cards.backTranslation: When this enters, you may search your library for an artifact card with mana value 3, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

cards.name: Manamorphose
lines: Add two mana in any combination of colors.
cards.backTranslation:
Add two mana of any color.
Draw a card.
differences: Text A adds two mana in any combination of colors (each mana may be a different color); Text B adds two mana of a single color (both mana the same color).
